coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 8 ground-truth variable items (38%, rounded): consistent use of R² as an evaluation metric, the main 80% training/20% testing split, and the 26 car-design parameters. Other items have only partial overlap or are missing.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the fixed CSV path. Replaces the specified training percentages with different sample-size tiers. Includes RandomForest and LightGBM and mentions XGBoost, but omits AutoGluon and the specified GradientBoosting model while introducing unrelated architectures. Does not implement the Fastback-only versus combined-dataset comparison; per-configuration reporting and leave-one-configuration-out tests are not equivalent. Uses five repetitions rather than average R² with confidence intervals over 20 splits.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected improvement with increased training data and the model-specific findings that AutoGluon performs well in the single-design scenario while LightGBM excels on the combined dataset.
